source: Codex: Orks (2026 leak), pp. 122-175; Munitorum Field Manual v1.4

rules.name: Get Stuck In
rules.description: Friendly ORKS units' melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: Headwoppa's Killchoppa
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. If this unit made a charge move this turn, this model's melee attacks have +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Da Boss is Watchin'
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. Once per battle, per army, in your Movement phase, this unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Kunnin' But Brutal
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. A fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot or declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Follow Me Ladz
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. This unit has +2 inches Move.

stratagems.name: Breakin' Heads
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly attached ORKS INFANTRY unit becomes battle-shocked. TARGET: That unit, even though it is battle-shocked. EFFECT: Roll one D3; the unit suffers that many mortal wounds and is no longer battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Mow 'Em Down
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS VEHICLE unit (excluding WALKER) that made a charge move is selected to fight. EFFECT: Its melee attacks have [CLEAVE 1], or improve existing [CLEAVE] by 1.

stratagems.name: Hit 'Em Harder
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight. EFFECT: Its melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Fungus-fuel Injection
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ORKS MOUNTED or VEHICLE unit is selected to move. EFFECT: It has +2 inches Move.

stratagems.name: Orks Is Never Beaten
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding TITANIC). EFFECT: Each destroyed model that has not fought fights before removal on a 4+, with +1 to the roll if the unit is riled up.

stratagems.name: Close-range Dakka
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot. EFFECT: Its ranged attacks have [RAPID FIRE 1], or improve existing [RAPID FIRE] by 1.

rules.name: Mob-handed Brutality
rules.description: Friendly BOYZ units' melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. If a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit made a charge move this turn, its melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].

enhancements.name: Ferocious Show-off
enhancements.description: ORKS INFANTRY model only. This model's melee attacks have +1 Attack, or +2 Attacks while this unit has 11+ models.

enhancements.name: 'Ardboyz
enhancements.description: BOYZ unit only. This unit has a 4+ Save.

stratagems.name: Unbridled Carnage
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly BOYZ unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight. EFFECT: Its melee attacks have +1 Attack.

stratagems.name: Mob Mentality
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of the battle-shock step of your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit of 13+ models. EFFECT: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12 inches; that unit's battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.

stratagems.name: 'Ere We Go
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ or BOYZ unit is selected to move. EFFECT: It has +2 to advance rolls.

rules.name: Displays of Savagery
rules.description: Friendly MEGANOBZ and NOBZ units' melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: Wimp-kickaz
enhancements.description: NOBZ unit only. An enemy unit engaged with this unit must use the desperate escape mode when it falls back; if this unit is riled up, subtract 1 from that enemy unit's hazard rolls.

enhancements.name: Tellyporta Boss
enhancements.description: MEGA ARMOUR model only. This unit (excluding VEHICLE units) has Deep Strike.

stratagems.name: Too Arrogant to Die
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ or NOBZ unit. EFFECT: Each destroyed model that has not fought fights before removal on a 4+, with +1 to the roll if the unit is riled up.

stratagems.name: Armed to da Teef
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly MEGANOBZ or NOBZ unit is selected to attack. EFFECT: Re-roll hit rolls of 1; if riled up, re-roll all hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Hulking Brutes
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy targets a friendly MEGANOBZ or NOBZ unit. EFFECT: Ranged attacks with Strength greater than the unit's Toughness have -1 to wound rolls. You can spend +1CP so all ranged attacks targeting the unit have -1 to wound rolls.

rules.name: Suspiciously Well Organised
rules.description: Friendly STORMBOYZ units have BATTLELINE. A fall-back move does not prevent a friendly BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Kill Kommanda
enhancements.description: BIG MEK or WARBOSS INFANTRY model only. While attached, this model has Infiltrators and Stealth.

enhancements.name: Throat-slittas
enhancements.description: KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit only. This unit's melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].

stratagems.name: Dubious Restraint
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start or end of your Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit. EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling; that objective is secured.

stratagems.name: Mind Mostly on the Mission
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit is selected to advance or fall back. EFFECT: That move does not prevent the unit from being eligible to start an action.

stratagems.name: While Their Backs Are Turned
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent's Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit that was engaged at the start of the phase. EFFECT: It can make a normal move of up to 6 inches.

rules.name: Wreckin' and Lootin'
rules.description: In your Shooting phase, friendly BREAKA BOYZ, FLASH GITZ and TANKBUSTAS units can re-roll hit rolls of 1 if the attacking unit or its target is within range of an objective.

enhancements.name: Kaptin's Hat
enhancements.description: BIG MEK or WARBOSS INFANTRY model only. After both armies deploy, redeploy up to two friendly ORKS INFANTRY units, including placing them in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Supa-snazz Dakka
enhancements.description: FLASH GITZ unit only. This unit's Snazzgun weapons have [RAPID FIRE 1].

stratagems.name: Drive-by Bustin'
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS TRANSPORT unit is selected to shoot. EFFECT: Its ranged weapons selected for the Firing Deck ability have +1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Grab It
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unengaged BREAKA BOYZ, FLASH GITZ or TANKBUSTAS unit has shot. EFFECT: It can make a normal move up to D6 inches; it cannot move within engagement range and cannot declare a charge or start an action this turn.

stratagems.name: Gun-crazy Show-offs
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot. TARGET: One friendly FLASH GITZ or TANKBUSTAS unit hit by those attacks. EFFECT: It shoots using normal shooting but can only target that enemy unit.

rules.name: Da Hunt Is On
rules.description: Friendly BEAST SNAGGA units' attacks that target a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit have +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Glory Hog
enhancements.description: BEAST SNAGGA model only. A fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: It Came from da Drops
enhancements.description: BEASTBOSS ON SQUIGOSAUR model only. This model has +1 Toughness.

stratagems.name: Where D'Ya Fink You're Going?
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit engaged with a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit is selected to fall back. EFFECT: It must use desperate escape and make one additional hazard roll for each friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit it is engaged with; if the enemy is a MONSTER or VEHICLE, subtract 1 from those hazard rolls.

stratagems.name: Goaded into Action
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot. TARGET: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit that lost a wound. EFFECT: It makes a surge move up to D6 inches; if riled up, re-roll that D6.

stratagems.name: Instinctive Hunters
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6 inches of a battlefield edge. EFFECT: Place it in strategic reserves.

rules.name: Unpredictable Genius
rules.description: In your Shooting phase, when all of a friendly BIG MEK, MEK GUNZ, MORKANAUT or WAZBOM BLASTAJET unit's ranged attacks target one enemy unit, roll one D6: 1, that target has a 4+ invulnerable save until your unit has shot; 2-3, select an enemy unit within 3 inches of the target to suffer D3 mortal wounds; 4, +1 to hit rolls; 5, the target has FLY and cannot have the benefit of cover until your unit has shot; 6, the target has -1 Toughness until your unit has shot.

enhancements.name: Mekwaaagh! Mastermind
enhancements.description: BIG MEK model only. This unit is riled up.

enhancements.name: Temperamental Shokka

names: Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun

enhancements.description: BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only. When selected to shoot, roll one D6: on 1, its Shokk Attack Gun has [TORRENT] and the model is destroyed after shooting; on 2-5 it has +1 Attack; on 6 it has [SUSTAINED HITS 2].

enhancements.name: Enhanced Runt-maw

names: Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun

enhancements.description: BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only. After this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks; it is infested with Snotlings until your next turn and has -1 Leadership while infested.

stratagems.name: Vindictive Artillerists
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MEK GUNZ unit is selected to shoot. EFFECT: Its ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS], or [SUSTAINED HITS 1], or both [HAZARDOUS] and [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

rules.name: Try Dat Button!
rules.description: When a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC) is selected to attack, roll one D6, or two D6 re-rolling duplicate results. Its attacks have: 1-2 +1 Attack; 3-4 +2 Strength; 5-6 +1 AP. If two dice were rolled, after attacking the unit makes one hazard roll.

enhancements.name: Cybork Boosta
enhancements.description: BIG MEK or MEK model only. This model has +2 inches Move.

enhancements.name: Dreadherder
enhancements.description: BIG MEK model only. While within 3 inches of a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding BIG MEK units), this model has Lone Operative. In your Shooting phase, one friendly ORKS WALKER unit within 3 inches can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Crazed Rampage
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC). EFFECT: Each destroyed model that has not fought fights before removal on a 4+, with +1 to the roll if it has DEFF DREAD.

stratagems.name: Dread Power
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly ORKS WALKER unit. EFFECT: It is riled up until the start of your next turn.

stratagems.name: Stomping Juggernaut
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit is selected to move or declare a charge. EFFECT: It has MOBILE.

rules.name: Unstoppable Momentum
rules.description: Friendly WAGON units can re-roll charge rolls. When a friendly WAGON unit advances, it can change its advance roll to 6.

enhancements.name: Targetin' Gizmos
enhancements.description: WAGON unit only. While a BIG MEK is embarked, this unit's ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER] and, if it is riled up, [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: Boss Boomer
enhancements.description: WAGON unit only. While a WARBOSS is embarked, this unit has that WARBOSS model's Intimidating Motivation or Keep Huntin' ability.

stratagems.name: Keep It Runnin'
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged ORKS INFANTRY unit eligible to fight and within 6 inches of a friendly TRANSPORT it can embark in. EFFECT: It embarks within that TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: Readied Brawlers
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a normal move. EFFECT: Units embarked within it can make an assault disembark move.

stratagems.name: Impending Krunch
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a charge move. EFFECT: Each enemy unit engaged with it makes a battle-shock roll with -1.

rules.name: Adrenaline Junkies
rules.description: Friendly WARBIKERS units have BATTLELINE. When a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit advances or falls back, its ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] and that move does not prevent it declaring a charge.

enhancements.name: Smoky Gubbinz
enhancements.description: SPEED FREEKS unit only (excluding AIRCRAFT). When an attack targets a unit not fully visible because of a model in this unit, the target has the benefit of cover.

enhancements.name: Competitive Streak
enhancements.description: DEFFKILLA WARTRIKE model only. This unit can re-roll charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Delicious Eating Squigs
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly RUKKATRUKK SQUIGBUGGIES unit. EFFECT: Select any number of friendly ORKS INFANTRY units within 3 inches; each heals 3 wounds.

stratagems.name: Dakkastorm
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to shoot. EFFECT: Its ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Speediest Freeks
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy targets a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit. EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target it fail on unmodified hit rolls of 1-3.

rules.name: Skyborne Loons
rules.description: Friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT units do not count towards the combined points value of your strategic reserves units. While a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT or DEFFKOPTAS unit is riled up, its ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Flyboss
enhancements.description: ORKS AIRCRAFT unit only. This unit has CHARACTER. When it ends an ingress move, each friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT or DEFFKOPTAS unit within 6 inches is riled up until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Impulsive Recon
enhancements.description: ORKS AIRCRAFT unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

stratagems.name: Flyin' Headbutt
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT unit is destroyed, before rolling Deadly Demise. EFFECT: The unit does not have Deadly Demise. Select one enemy unit within 2 inches and roll eight D6; for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. Then remove your unit.

stratagems.name: Long, Uncontrolled Bursts
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT or DEFFKOPTAS unit is selected to shoot. EFFECT: When its ranged attacks target a FLY unit, re-roll hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Whirligig Evasion
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move. TARGET: One friendly unengaged DEFFKOPTAS unit within 8 inches. EFFECT: It can make a normal move up to D6 inches, or up to 6 inches if riled up.

rules.name: 'Ard as Nails
rules.description: When a friendly WARBOSS model is destroyed, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6 with +1 if its unit is riled up. On a 3+, it fights before removal.

enhancements.name: Surly as a Squiggoth
enhancements.description: INFANTRY WARBOSS model only. Once per battle, per army, at the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6. On a 2+, set it up as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Brutal But Kunnin'
enhancements.description: WARBOSS model only. This model's melee attacks have +1 Damage.

enhancements.name: Blitzboss
enhancements.description: WARBOSS model only. A TRANSPORT unit (excluding WALKER) this unit is embarked within has +2 inches Move and a 5+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Proper Killy
enhancements.description: WARBOSS model only. This model can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Morgog's Finkin' Cap
enhancements.description: WARBOSS model only. Once per battle, per army, at the end of your opponent's Movement phase, if unengaged, this unit can make a normal move up to D6 inches; if riled up, re-roll that D6.

enhancements.name: Da Gobshot Thunderbuss
enhancements.description: WARBOSS model only. This model has Da Gobshot Thunderbuss: Range 24 inches, A6, BS4+, S7, AP-1, D2, [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE, RAPID FIRE 6].

rules.name: Powers of da Waaagh!
rules.description: Friendly ORKS PSYKER models' [PSYCHIC] attacks have +1 Strength, plus +1 Strength for every 5 models in their unit or embarked within their model. They know Roar of Mork (psychic level 1): in your Movement phase, roll one D6; on 1 the unit is battle-shocked, otherwise select one non-MONSTER/VEHICLE enemy within 12 inches and it takes a battle-shock roll with -1 for every 10 models in this unit. They also know Visions of Violence (psychic level 1): at the start of the Fight phase, roll one D6; on 1 the unit is battle-shocked, otherwise it has Fights First.

enhancements.name: Da Krunch
enhancements.description: ORKS PSYKER model only. This model has Da Krunch: Range 24 inches, A3, BS4+, S5, AP-1, D1, [BLAST 3, HAZARDOUS, LETHAL HITS, PSYCHIC].

enhancements.name: 'Eadbanger
enhancements.description: ORKS PSYKER model only. This model has 'Eadbanger: Range 24 inches, A2, BS4+, S6, AP-2, D3, [HAZARDOUS, PRECISION, PSYCHIC].

enhancements.name: Warphead
enhancements.description: ORKS PSYKER model only. This model has Psyker Level 2, Deadly Demise D6, and can re-roll psychic rolls.

rules.name: Sneaky Little Gitz
rules.description: Friendly GRETCHIN units have BATTLELINE. When a friendly GRETCHIN unit advances or falls back, that move does not prevent it being eligible to start an action.

enhancements.name: Extra Sneaky
enhancements.description: GRETCHIN unit only. This unit has -3 inches detection range.

enhancements.name: Minefield Detail
enhancements.description: GRETCHIN unit only. While this unit is not embarked, it has Scouts 6 inches.

stratagems.name: Infested War Zone
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when an enemy unit has attacked. TARGET: One friendly GRETCHIN unit just destroyed; it can be targeted even though destroyed. EFFECT: Add a new identical GRETCHIN unit to your army, in strategic reserves, at starting strength with half its wounds remaining.

stratagems.name: Scarper!
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8 inches of a friendly unengaged GRETCHIN unit. EFFECT: It can make a normal move up to D6 inches, or up to 6 inches instead if it is an attached unit.

stratagems.name: Grot Shields
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy targets a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit (excluding GRETCHIN). TARGET: One friendly GRETCHIN unit within 3 inches of that ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: On each failed save for the ORKS unit, one GRETCHIN model suffers 1 mortal wound.

rules.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
rules.description: Friendly ORKS INFANTRY units' ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. While such a unit is riled up, it has +3 inches Range.

enhancements.name: Supa-glowy Fing
enhancements.description: ORKS INFANTRY model only (excluding WEIRDBOY). This model's ranged attacks have [ANTI-INFANTRY 4+], [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] and [SUPA-HAZARDOUS]. Each time its unit shoots, after resolving its attacks, make two hazard rolls for each [SUPA-HAZARDOUS] weapon selected.

enhancements.name: Targetin' Squigs
enhancements.description: BIG MEK, BIGBOSS or WARBOSS model only. This unit's ranged attacks (excluding [TORRENT]) have +3 inches Range.

stratagems.name: Kustom Dakka
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot. EFFECT: Its ranged attacks that target a unit excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Glowin' Dakka
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot. EFFECT: Its ranged attacks that target a unit within 9 inches have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Never Enough Dakka
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot. EFFECT: Its ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
